note: the export-local-to-reconstruction transform: how a block coordinate actually read out of pilot.litematic maps back to a cell on transform.json's camera-space lattice. Add minimum_shift to a read-back local block coordinate, run block_to_cell (giving footprint.py's own local, 0-indexed-from-row_offset/column_offset cell), then add row_offset/column_offset to reach the world cell transform.json's lattice and cell_corners_pixels expect.
